Amerika ke raksha vibhag ne chin ke khufiya spes plen ki pahli spasht tasvir jari ki hai. vaise to is yan ki tasvir 2024 se hi sarvajnik rup se uplabdh hai, lekin dhundhli hone ki vajah se ismen plen ke bare men jyada jankari nahin pata chal pa rahi thi. magar haliya tasvir is spes plen ke bare men kaee dilchasp jankariyan ujagar karti hai.
Riport pavel eksanov, bibisi rusi seva ke lie sainy vishleshak
